body: I notice the note on the corner of my desk, the handwriting familiar yet unfamiliar at the same time. I think about my colleague, wondering what could be bothering them. Their usual confidence and outgoing nature seems a bit subdued. I lean back in my chair, and my mind starts to fill with all the things I could do to support them. I think about the conversations we've had in the past, the times when they needed a listening ear, and I want to provide that same support now. I reach for a comforting phrase I've used before: "We'll get through this together, just let me know how I can help."
